snippet.title: INMOST - Mobile Trailer [Google Play Android]
snippet.description:
INMOST is an emotional and deeply atmospheric narrative-driven puzzle platformer. Explore the hauntingly beautiful world of three playable characters, in one dark, interconnected story. 

Explore a crumbling, nightmarish landscape, slice through enemies, and spring deadly traps in order to escape the evil that awaits...

Available on Google Play: https://bit.ly/INMOSTAndroid

INMOST is playable in 14 languages, including English, French, German, Russian, Spanish, Italian, Arabic, Dutch, Japanese, Korean, Brazilian Portuguese, Turkish, Simplified and Traditional Chinese

Developed by Hidden Layer Games & published by Chucklefish. 

Join the community and maybe even find your adventure buddies over on our discord: discord.gg/chucklefish
